proof_boundary: This artifact proves an exact equivalence of all-order target formulations, identifies a strict two-column Hankel sufficient target, and records an exact Xi/Phi logarithmic-derivative handoff. It does not prove the all-order Stieltjes property, coefficient PF-infinity, Jensen hyperbolicity for zeta, RH, or Lambda <= 0.

exact.sokal_criterion: For entire H with H(0)!=0: H in LP+ <=> (a_r)_(r>=0) is a Stieltjes moment sequence
exact.unique_measure: a_r=integral_[0,infinity)x^r*dnu(x), nu=gamma*delta_0+sum_j m_j*beta_j*delta_(beta_j), gamma>=0, beta_j>0, m_j in Z_(>=1), sum_j m_j*beta_j<infinity
exact.hankel_psd: a is Stieltjes <=> (a_(i+j))_(i,j>=0) and (a_(i+j+1))_(i,j>=0) are positive semidefinite on every finite block
exact.strict_two_column_target: D_(m,1)=det(p_(i+j+1))_(i,j=0)^m>0 and D_(m,2)=det(p_(i+j+2))_(i,j=0)^m>0 for every m>=0 => a is Stieltjes
exact.s_fraction: a is Stieltjes <=> sum_(r>=0)a_r*t^r has a formal Stieltjes continued fraction with nonnegative coefficients, including terminating cases
exact.endpoint_equivalence: c is PF-infinity <=> H is LP+ <=> a_r=p_(r+1) is Stieltjes <=> every shifted Jensen window is finite PF-infinity
exact.finite_guard: finitely many positive D_(m,s), log signs, or recurrence coefficients do not imply the all-order Stieltjes moment property
exact.object_separation: Hankel matrices of a_r=p_(r+1) are nonlinear Edrei-log objects and are not the original signed-Hankel matrices of A_k
exact.mixture_guard: positivity of the Phi integral or fixed-scale LP+ kernels does not imply that their positive mixture has Stieltjes logarithmic derivative

rows.claim: The normalized coefficient generating function is entire and has unit constant term.
rows.proof_boundary: Known analytic normalization only; no zero-location conclusion.

rows.claim: The shifted signed Edrei-log powers are exactly the Taylor coefficients of the signed logarithmic derivative.
rows.proof_boundary: Formal identity near zero; audited independently at exact rational coefficients.

rows.claim: Sokal's logarithmic-derivative criterion makes the all-order shifted Stieltjes property equivalent to LP+ for an entire function.
rows.formula: For entire H with H(0)!=0: H in LP+ <=> (a_r)_(r>=0) is a Stieltjes moment sequence
rows.proof_boundary: The criterion identifies an endpoint-equivalent target; it does not prove the Stieltjes antecedent for zeta.

rows.claim: Entireness forces any Stieltjes representing measure for the logarithmic derivative into the discrete Edrei zero-measure form with integer residues.
rows.formula: a_r=integral_[0,infinity)x^r*dnu(x), nu=gamma*delta_0+sum_j m_j*beta_j*delta_(beta_j), gamma>=0, beta_j>0, m_j in Z_(>=1), sum_j m_j*beta_j<infinity
rows.proof_boundary: Conditional on the all-order Stieltjes property.

rows.claim: The representing measure is equivalently a Stieltjes-transform representation of the logarithmic derivative.
rows.proof_boundary: An exact target representation, not an established representation for H_0.

rows.claim: The Stieltjes moment property is equivalent to positivity of both unshifted and once-shifted Hankel quadratic forms at every finite size.
rows.formula: a is Stieltjes <=> (a_(i+j))_(i,j>=0) and (a_(i+j+1))_(i,j>=0) are positive semidefinite on every finite block
rows.proof_boundary: All sizes are required; finite blocks remain diagnostics.

rows.claim: Strict positivity of the two leading power-Hankel columns s=1 and s=2 at every order is a clean sufficient endpoint theorem.
rows.formula: D_(m,1)=det(p_(i+j+1))_(i,j=0)^m>0 and D_(m,2)=det(p_(i+j+2))_(i,j=0)^m>0 for every m>=0 => a is Stieltjes
rows.proof_boundary: Open for all m; currently checked only on a finite staircase.

rows.claim: A nonnegative Stieltjes continued fraction is an exact alternative all-order certificate for the same shifted moment sequence.
rows.formula: a is Stieltjes <=> sum_(r>=0)a_r*t^r has a formal Stieltjes continued fraction with nonnegative coefficients, including terminating cases
rows.proof_boundary: Requires every continued-fraction coefficient or a valid terminating certificate.

rows.claim: The Edrei-log Stieltjes target joins the already unified coefficient-PF and Jensen-window endpoint.
rows.formula: c is PF-infinity <=> H is LP+ <=> a_r=p_(r+1) is Stieltjes <=> every shifted Jensen window is finite PF-infinity
rows.proof_boundary: Equivalence of targets only; no endpoint statement is proved for zeta.

rows.claim: The existing log-sign, power-Hankel, and recurrence artifacts test finite pieces of this exact Stieltjes target.
rows.formula: 320 log-sign rows; 4205 power-Hankel rows; 55 positive recurrence rows through order 12
rows.proof_boundary: Finite evidence only; higher recurrence orders are inconclusive and all-order positivity is open.

rows.claim: The viable Edrei-log Hankel target is not invalidated by the order-ten failure of the original A_k signed-Hankel antecedent.
rows.formula: Hankel matrices of a_r=p_(r+1) are nonlinear Edrei-log objects and are not the original signed-Hankel matrices of A_k
rows.proof_boundary: Prevents conflation of two different Hankel constructions.

rows.claim: No finite determinant or recurrence prefix enters the all-order equivalence.
rows.formula: finitely many positive D_(m,s), log signs, or recurrence coefficients do not imply the all-order Stieltjes moment property

rows.claim: The Phi moment integral gives an exact ratio whose proof as a Stieltjes function would establish the endpoint noncircularly.
rows.proof_boundary: The ratio identity is exact; its Stieltjes property is open and does not follow from positivity of the integrands.

rows.claim: Positive mixing of fixed-scale LP+ kernels is not a preservation theorem for the logarithmic-derivative Stieltjes class.
rows.formula: positivity of the Phi integral or fixed-scale LP+ kernels does not imply that their positive mixture has Stieltjes logarithmic derivative
rows.proof_boundary: The existing exact scale-mixture countermodel remains active.
